title: System Context Diagram
alt: Praetor boundaries, agent interactions, git providers, and downstream infrastructure.
text: Boxes: Software Engineer / Operator, Autonomous AI Coding Agent (fed by compile-context), Operational Fork, Git Provider (GitHub enforces), ARC Runner Scale Sets (operational fork deploy/arc/), GitOps Controller (operational fork deploy/k8s/).
Software Engineer / Operator → Praetor Engine (invokes commands / verifies PRs).
Autonomous AI Coding Agent → Praetor Engine (reads AGENTS.md / runs checks).
Operational Fork → Praetor Engine (harvests requirements & dogfoods) → Git Provider (enforces branch protection & checks).
Praetor Engine → ARC Runner Scale Sets (resolves runner routing to scale-set names).

edges.label: resolves runner routing to scale-set names
